name: Internet and surveillance
description: State control over communications and data.

laws.name: Open internet
laws.description: No content filtering; surveillance requires judicial warrants.

laws.name: Regulated internet
laws.description: Limited takedown rules and lawful intercept with oversight.

laws.name: Mass surveillance
laws.description: Bulk collection of communications data with weak oversight.

laws.name: Filtered internet
laws.description: National filtering of political and foreign content.

laws.name: Sovereign internet
laws.description: A national network that can be cut off from the global internet.
